title: Bobby Bones Presents: The BobbyCast Hits 10-Year Anniversary
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*The iHeartPodcast Celebrates Almost 700 Episodes Cementing Bones as One of the Top Personalities in Entertainment, The BobbyCast Recently Joined Netflix’s Global Slate in Partnership with iHeartMedia*


NASHVILLE, TN (September 3, 2026) — Ten years and almost 700 episodes,


[Bobby Bones](https://www.instagram.com/mrbobbybones/?hl=en) has turned a microphone and an insatiable curiosity into a global media franchise. This month, iHeartPodcast Bobby Bones Presents: The BobbyCast celebrates its 10th anniversary, marking a decade of genuine and surprising conversations with the biggest stars in music, entertainment, sports and culture.


What started as a place for Bobby to have more intimate and in-depth discussions with those he admired has grown into a podcast juggernaut with a worldwide platform, garnering over 92 million monthly social media impressions and 5.4 million social media followers.


In January, The BobbyCast became the first Nashville-based podcast to debut on Netflix, as part of the streamer’s inaugural deal with iHeartMedia, bringing Bobby to a global audience.


“The BobbyCast started as an opportunity to have real, candid conversations with people I was curious to learn more about,” said Bobby Bones. “Ten years later, I’m still curious, and I’m incredibly grateful that people continue to want to confide in me.”


The force behind The Bobby Bones Show, America’s #1 country morning show, and the popular Country Top 30 with Bobby Bones weekend show, which reach more than 10M listeners monthly across more than 200 stations nationwide, Bobby was an early believer in the power of podcasting, launching The BobbyCast long before podcasts became a central part of the celebrity ecosystem.


A prolific award winner, 2x New York Times best-selling author, stand-up comedian, chart-topping recording artist, philanthropist, Dancing with the Stars’ winner and the youngest-ever inductee into the National Radio Hall of Fame, Bobby has built a reach that spans syndicated radio, podcasting, social platforms and global streaming, making him one of today’s most dynamic and successful personalities in entertainment.


“For the past 10 years, 'The BobbyCast' has earned a reputation as one of podcasting’s most respected interview shows. Bobby’s curiosity and ability to create genuine conversations make the podcast a favorite among listeners and guests, and we’re proud to celebrate this milestone with him," said Will Pearson, President of iHeartPodcasts.


Additionally, Bobby’s podcast network in partnership with iHeartMedia (Nashville Podcast Network) includes series like 25 Whistles with Bobby Bones (A Football Podcast), Battleground Podcast, Feeling Things with Amy & Kat, Get Real with Caroline Hobby, In The Vet's Office with Dr. Josie Horchak, Movie Mike's Movie Podcast, Sore Losers, The Upload with Brooke Taylor and more.

**About Bobby Bones**


[Bobby Bones](https://www.instagram.com/mrbobbybones/?hl=en) “has carved out a place for himself in nearly every corner of the entertainment world” (American Profile). A magnetic, multi-hyphenate, Bones is the force behind America’s #1 Country morning show The Bobby Bones Show and the popular Country Top 30 with Bobby Bones weekend show on iHeartRadio, which reach more than 10 million listeners monthly across 200 stations nationwide. The award-winning show is a four-time CMA Award and four-time ACM Award winner and earned Bones the distinction of becoming the youngest-ever inductee into the prestigious National Radio Hall of Fame. The “media multitasker” (Billboard) has also emerged as an early force in podcasting with his podcast, Bobby Bones Presents: The BobbyCast. In January 2026, The BobbyCast became the first Nashville-based podcast to debut on Netflix, bringing Bones’ candid, revealing long-form conversations with top artists, actors, athletes and industry heavyweights to a global audience. Beyond radio and podcasting, Bones is a two-time #1 New York Times bestselling author and winner of ABC’s Dancing with the Stars. For more information, visit


[BobbyBones.com](http://bobbybones.com/) .
